title: VTA WebVH Agent-Name Check — payload
description: Ask whether a name is free before trying to take it.

did.description: DID the name is bound to.

name.description: The name, without the host — the full form is `<host>/@<name>`.

Response.title: VTA WebVH Agent-Name Check — response payload

domain.description: Host the name would live under. A name is only unique within its host.

available.description: Whether the name can be taken **now**. It is a snapshot, not a hold: another caller may take it between this answer and the attempt.

reserved.description: Whether the name is withheld by the host's own policy rather than taken by a DID. A reserved name is not available and will not become so by waiting.
